card.name: First-person statements in personal blog text
card.fires_on: Words right after a first-person subject like I or we in informal web writing, such as imagine, know, use, liked, saved. Also fires on words inside the writer's own personal phrases, like my mind or I, on the other hand.

modes.label: Verb after I/we
modes.description: A verb or quantity word following I or we as the writer describes their own actions or knowledge.
modes.example: I know<< some>> of the answers, of course–acting

modes.label: Inside personal phrases
modes.description: A word completing a set phrase about the writer's own view or experience.
modes.example: would never have crossed my<< mind>>: How does each school deal with cyber

modes.label: Writer's own tools or methods
modes.description: A past-tense verb after we in a how-to blog describing what the writer did.
modes.example: We<< saved>> our file to a special directory on our

card.plain: It lights up on the word after a blogger says I or we, when they describe what they did, know or think.
